title: Implement reusable mutation runner and P0.6 parity workflow
objective: Implement a command-free reusable mutation-profile runner and engineering-branch parity workflow, then prove P0.6 profile execution preserves the legacy mutation semantics before any trigger migration.
non_goals: migrate P0.6 main or pull-request triggers
define or adopt the Lot45 mutation profile
modify Lot45 candidate or business code
introduce paid services or mandatory LLM review

forbidden_semantics: legacy P0.6 workflow migration or deletion
main or pull-request mutation trigger migration

required_invariants: runner accepts only a validated enabled profile id from the declarative registry
profile JSON never supplies shell commands executable names argv or environment injection
P0.6 execution uses CURRENT_CHECKOUT and the locked mutmut 3.5.0 toolchain
runner materializes profile-specific mutmut settings without changing production Python source
P0.6 target tests also-copy score numerator denominator threshold timeout policy and do-not-mutate patterns remain parity-bound to WU10 data
runner restores canonical pyproject.toml and verifies configured source immutability after mutation execution
evidence serialization is deterministic and records exact source head profile version counts formula threshold and PASS or FAIL
engineering parity workflow runs WU10 validator and selftests before invoking mutation
legacy P0.6 workflow remains byte-identical during WU11
Lot45 profile workflow and business code remain untouched
acceptance_criteria: validate_mutation_profiles.py passes before generic mutation execution
selftest_mutation_profiles.py passes before generic mutation execution
runner validate-only mode proves exact P0.6 materialized configuration without executing mutmut
runner rejects unknown disabled ambiguous or non-CURRENT_CHECKOUT profiles in WU11
runner invokes only the locked mutmut console entrypoint with fixed run/results argv and rejects an entrypoint outside the active Python environment
P0.6 evidence score is computed as killed plus timeout over killed plus timeout plus suspicious plus survived with minimum 80 percent
source immutability check leaves src/crypto_quant_bot unchanged and restores pyproject.toml
ci-mutation.yml is engineering-branch parity only plus workflow_dispatch and does not adopt main pull_request triggers
legacy p06-extended-mutation.yml Git blob remains b1653c0c392e74ea7f50b7b922fd8750fa402bb7
parity evidence binds the exact generic workflow run and head before WU12 can begin

target_commands: GitHub Actions ci-mutation P0.6 parity workflow

done_when: generic runner executes only validated declarative mutation profiles
P0.6 generic execution has exact-head parity evidence
legacy P0.6 workflow remains unchanged and active until WU12
no Lot45 or institutional mutation behavior is migrated
